fields.name: origin
fields.help: Reference of the document that generated this purchase order request (e.g. a sales order)

fields.name: partner_ref
fields.help: Reference of the sales order or bid sent by the vendor. It's used to do the matching when you receive the products as this reference is usually written on the delivery order sent by your vendor.

fields.name: date_order
fields.help: Depicts the date within which the Quotation should be confirmed and converted into a purchase order.

fields.name: partner_id
fields.help: You can find a vendor by its Name, TIN, Email or Internal Reference.

fields.name: dest_address_id
fields.help: Put an address if you want to deliver directly from the vendor to the customer. Otherwise, keep empty to deliver to your own company.

fields.name: locked
fields.help: Locked Purchase Orders cannot be modified.

fields.name: acknowledged
fields.help: It indicates that the vendor has acknowledged the receipt of the purchase order.

fields.name: date_planned
fields.help: Delivery date promised by vendor. This date is used to determine expected arrival of products.

fields.name: tax_country_id
fields.help: Technical field to filter the available taxes depending on the fiscal country and fiscal position.

fields.name: incoterm_id
fields.help: International Commercial Terms are a series of predefined commercial terms used in international transactions.

fields.name: purchase_warning_text
fields.help: Internal warning for the partner or the products as set by the user.

fields.name: picking_type_id
fields.help: This will determine operation type of incoming shipment

fields.name: default_location_dest_id_usage
fields.help: Technical field used to display the Drop Ship Address

fields.name: effective_date
fields.help: Completion date of the first receipt order.

fields.name: receipt_status
fields.help:
Red: Late
            Orange: To process today
            Green: On time

fields.string: Technical field for whether the purchase order has associated sale orders

fields.name: report_grids

fields.name: grid_product_tmpl_id
fields.help: Technical field for product_matrix functionalities.

fields.name: grid_update
fields.help: Whether the grid field contains a new matrix to apply or not.

fields.name: grid
fields.help:
Technical storage of grid. 
If grid_update, will be loaded on the PO. 
If not, represents the matrix to open.

fields.name: receipt_status
fields.decoration-danger: date_planned and (date_planned < effective_date or date_planned < datetime.datetime.combine(datetime.date.today(), datetime.time(0,0,0)).to_utc().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S') and receipt_status!='full' and effective_date <= date_planned)
fields.decoration-warning: date_planned and date_planned >= datetime.datetime.combine(datetime.date.today(), datetime.time(0,0,0)).to_utc().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S') and date_planned <= datetime.datetime.combine(datetime.date.today(), datetime.time(23,59,59)).to_utc().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S') and receipt_status!='full'

window_actions.name: Requests for Quotation
window_actions.help:
No request for quotation found. Let's create one!

Requests for quotation are documents that will be sent to your suppliers to request prices for different products you consider buying. Once an agreement has been found with the supplier, they will be confirmed and turned into purchase orders.

window_actions.name: Purchase Orders
window_actions.help:
No purchase order found. Let's create one!

Once you ordered your products to your supplier, confirm your request for quotation and it will turn into a purchase order.

window_actions.name: RFQs and Purchases
window_actions.help:
This vendor has no purchase order. Create a new RfQ

The request for quotation is the first step of the purchases flow. Once converted into a purchase order, you will be able to control the receipt of the products and the vendor bill.
